headers.title: Content-Security-Policy missing
headers.impact: No CSP to limit the impact of XSS or injected third-party content.
headers.remediation: Send a Content-Security-Policy; start with a nonce-based strict policy.

headers.title: CSP allows inline scripts ('unsafe-inline')
headers.impact: Injected inline scripts run, so the CSP gives little XSS protection.
headers.remediation: Replace 'unsafe-inline' in script-src with nonces or hashes.

headers.title: CSP script sources include wildcards
headers.impact: Scripts can load from any host/scheme listed, bypassing the policy.
headers.remediation: Drop *, scheme-only (https:, data:) sources from script-src/default-src.

headers.title: Strict-Transport-Security missing
headers.impact: First visits and typed http:// links can be downgraded/intercepted (SSL stripping).
headers.remediation: Send Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains.

headers.title: Response sets a cookie but is publicly cacheable
headers.impact: A shared cache/CDN may store and serve one user's Set-Cookie to others.
headers.remediation: Use Cache-Control: no-store (or private) on responses that set cookies.

headers.title: No clickjacking protection (frame-ancestors / X-Frame-Options)
headers.impact: The page can be framed by any site and used for clickjacking.
headers.remediation: Add CSP frame-ancestors 'self' (or 'none'); optionally X-Frame-Options: DENY.

headers.title: Debug/profiler header exposed
headers.impact: Debug tooling (e.g. Symfony profiler, ChromeLogger) can leak config, queries, secrets.
headers.remediation: Disable debug mode/profilers in production.

headers.title: Security header sent more than once with different values
headers.impact: Browsers keep the first value or ignore the header entirely, so the intended policy may not apply (often two layers, e.g. app and proxy, both setting it).
headers.remediation: Set each security header in exactly one place.

headers.title: CSP missing base-uri
headers.impact: An injected <base> tag can redirect relative script URLs.
headers.remediation: Add base-uri 'none' (or 'self').

headers.title: CSP allows eval ('unsafe-eval')
headers.impact: String-to-code sinks (eval, new Function) stay usable for injected input.
headers.remediation: Remove 'unsafe-eval'; refactor code that needs eval.

headers.title: Deprecated header: public-key-pins
headers.impact: HPKP removed from browsers; stale pins can lock out legacy clients.
headers.remediation: Remove public-key-pins.

headers.title: CSP frame-ancestors allows any origin
headers.impact: Any site may frame the page; this also overrides X-Frame-Options.
headers.remediation: Restrict frame-ancestors to 'self' or named origins.

headers.title: Strict-Transport-Security lacks includeSubDomains
headers.impact: Subdomains can still be reached over HTTP, enabling cookie injection.
headers.remediation: Add includeSubDomains once all subdomains serve HTTPS.

headers.title: Strict-Transport-Security max-age too short
headers.impact: Protection lapses quickly for infrequent visitors.
headers.remediation: Use max-age of at least 15552000 (180 days); 31536000+ recommended.

headers.title: Private IP address disclosed in headers
headers.impact: Reveals internal network layout.
headers.remediation: Strip or rewrite headers carrying internal addresses at the edge.

headers.title: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff missing
headers.impact: Browsers may MIME-sniff responses into executable types.
headers.remediation: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all responses.

headers.title: Permissions-Policy grants powerful features to all origins
headers.impact: Any embedded origin may request the listed features.
headers.remediation: Replace =* with () or an explicit origin list.

headers.title: Referrer-Policy leaks full URLs
headers.impact: Full URLs (paths, query tokens) are sent to other origins.
headers.remediation: Use strict-origin-when-cross-origin, same-origin, or no-referrer.

headers.title: Server-Timing exposes backend metrics
headers.impact: Timing data can reveal backend components and aid timing side-channels.
headers.remediation: Send Server-Timing only to internal/debug clients.

headers.title: Software version disclosed in headers
headers.impact: Exact versions make it trivial to match known CVEs.
headers.remediation: Remove versions from Server/X-Powered-By (e.g. ServerTokens Prod, expose_php Off).

headers.title: Backend/internal server identity disclosed
headers.impact: Internal host names or upstreams aid reconnaissance.
headers.remediation: Strip backend-identifying headers at the proxy/load balancer.

headers.title: ETag may disclose file inode (Apache)
headers.impact: Inode numbers leak filesystem details (CVE-2003-1418).
headers.remediation: Apache: FileETag MTime Size.

headers.title: Response has no Content-Type
headers.impact: Browsers sniff the type, which can turn uploaded or reflected content into HTML/script.
headers.remediation: Send an explicit Content-Type (with charset for text) on every response with a body.

headers.title: Likely-sensitive page cacheable (no Cache-Control: no-store)
headers.impact: Account/login content may persist in browser or proxy caches.
headers.remediation: Send Cache-Control: no-store on authenticated/sensitive pages.

headers.title: CDN/WAF detected: Cloudflare
headers.impact: Informational: edge provider in front of the origin.
headers.remediation: None.

headers.title: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy not set
headers.impact: The page is not cross-origin isolated (needed for Spectre-hardening features).
headers.remediation: If isolation is wanted, send Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp.

headers.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy not set
headers.impact: Cross-origin windows keep a reference to this page (XS-Leaks, tabnabbing).
headers.remediation: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin (or same-origin-allow-popups).

headers.title: Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy not set
headers.impact: Other origins can embed this resource (Spectre-style side channels).
headers.remediation: Send Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin (or same-site).

headers.title: Deprecated header: expect-ct
headers.impact: Obsolete; browsers enforce Certificate Transparency.
headers.remediation: Remove expect-ct.

headers.title: Deprecated header: feature-policy
headers.impact: Replaced by Permissions-Policy.
headers.remediation: Remove feature-policy.

headers.title: Deprecated header: p3p
headers.impact: Obsolete privacy header, ignored by browsers.
headers.remediation: Remove p3p.

headers.title: Deprecated header: public-key-pins-report-only
headers.impact: HPKP removed from browsers.
headers.remediation: Remove public-key-pins-report-only.

headers.title: Deprecated header: x-content-security-policy
headers.impact: Prefixed CSP; use Content-Security-Policy.
headers.remediation: Remove x-content-security-policy.

headers.title: Deprecated header: x-webkit-csp
headers.impact: Prefixed CSP; use Content-Security-Policy.
headers.remediation: Remove x-webkit-csp.

headers.title: Deprecated header: x-xss-protection
headers.impact: XSS auditor removed from browsers; set 0 or drop it, rely on CSP.
headers.remediation: Remove x-xss-protection.

headers.title: X-Frame-Options set without CSP frame-ancestors
headers.impact: Protected today; frame-ancestors is the standard and supports allow-lists.
headers.remediation: Add CSP frame-ancestors matching the X-Frame-Options intent.

headers.title: Strict-Transport-Security not preload-ready
headers.impact: The host can't join browser HSTS preload lists, so first visits stay exposed.
headers.remediation: Use max-age≥31536000; includeSubDomains; preload, then submit to hstspreload.org.

headers.title: Permissions-Policy not set
headers.impact: Embedded content may request powerful features (camera, geolocation, ...).
headers.remediation: Send Permissions-Policy disabling unused features, e.g. camera=(), microphone=().

headers.title: HTTP/2 / HTTP/3 support

evidence.value: HTTP/3: not advertised (no h3 in Alt-Svc)

headers.impact: Informational.
headers.remediation: None.

headers.title: Referrer-Policy not set
headers.impact: Browser default (strict-origin-when-cross-origin) applies; behavior is implicit.
headers.remediation: Set Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin (or stricter).

headers.title: Technology disclosed in headers
headers.impact: Reveals the stack, aiding targeted attacks.
headers.remediation: Remove X-Powered-By and similar headers.

headers.title: Timing-Allow-Origin: * exposes detailed timing to any site
headers.impact: Cross-origin pages can read precise resource timing, aiding cross-site leak attacks.
headers.remediation: Limit Timing-Allow-Origin to origins that need it.

headers.title: Request/trace ID headers exposed
headers.impact: Low risk; reveals tracing stack and lets requests be correlated.
headers.remediation: Optional: strip tracing headers at the edge.

cookies.title: Cookie 'PHPSESSID': missing HttpOnly
cookies.impact: Page scripts (and so any XSS) can read the cookie.
cookies.remediation: Add HttpOnly unless client-side JavaScript genuinely needs the value.

cookies.title: Cookie 'PHPSESSID': missing Secure
cookies.impact: The cookie is also sent over plain HTTP, where it can be intercepted.
cookies.remediation: Add the Secure attribute.

cookies.title: Cookie '__Host-auth': Domain=shop.test shares it with all subdomains

evidence.value: __Host-auth=[value not recorded]; Domain=shop.test; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict

cookies.impact: Every subdomain (including any compromised or third-party-hosted one) receives and can overwrite the cookie.
cookies.remediation: Omit Domain to make the cookie host-only, or use the __Host- prefix.

cookies.title: Cookie 'remember_me': Domain=shop.test shares it with all subdomains

evidence.value: remember_me=[value not recorded]; Domain=.shop.test; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=2592000

cookies.impact: Every subdomain (including any compromised or third-party-hosted one) receives and can overwrite the cookie.
cookies.remediation: Omit Domain to make the cookie host-only, or use the __Host- prefix.

cookies.title: Cookie 'PHPSESSID': missing SameSite
cookies.impact: Cross-site behavior depends on browser defaults (Lax in some, not all).
cookies.remediation: Set SameSite=Lax (or Strict); use None only for real cross-site use, with Secure.

cookies.title: Cookie '__Secure-pref': missing Secure
cookies.impact: The cookie is also sent over plain HTTP, where it can be intercepted.
cookies.remediation: Add the Secure attribute.

cookies.title: Cookie '__Host-auth': __Host- prefix rules broken (has a Domain attribute)

evidence.value: __Host-auth=[value not recorded]; Domain=shop.test; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict

cookies.impact: Browsers reject the cookie, so the protection the prefix promises is absent (and the feature relying on it may silently fail).
cookies.remediation: __Secure-: Secure + HTTPS. __Host-: Secure + HTTPS + Path=/ + no Domain.

cookies.title: Cookie '__Host-auth': __Host- prefix rules broken (set over plain HTTP, has a Domain attribute)

evidence.value: __Host-auth=[value not recorded]; Domain=shop.test; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict

cookies.impact: Browsers reject the cookie, so the protection the prefix promises is absent (and the feature relying on it may silently fail).
cookies.remediation: __Secure-: Secure + HTTPS. __Host-: Secure + HTTPS + Path=/ + no Domain.

cookies.remediation: __Secure-: Secure + HTTPS. __Host-: Secure + HTTPS + Path=/ + no Domain.

cookies.title: Cookie '__Secure-pref': __Secure- prefix rules broken (no Secure attribute, set over plain HTTP)

cookies.remediation: __Secure-: Secure + HTTPS. __Host-: Secure + HTTPS + Path=/ + no Domain.

cookies.title: Cookie 'legacy': SameSite=None without Secure
cookies.impact: Modern browsers reject it; older ones send it on every cross-site request.
cookies.remediation: Add Secure to SameSite=None cookies.

cookies.title: Cookie 'tracker': SameSite=None without Secure

cookies.remediation: Add Secure to SameSite=None cookies.

cookies.title: Cookie 'PHPSESSID': Path=/ set by a sub-path application
cookies.impact: Other applications on the same host receive the cookie (Path is not a strong boundary, but narrows exposure).
cookies.remediation: If the app lives under /account/, set Path accordingly.
